1.o: يُسجن مايكل سكوفيلد في سجن فوكس ريفر ستيت. يجد شقيقه، لينكون بوروز، المحكوم عليه بالإعدام، ويخبره أنه سيخرجهما من السجن.

2.o: المشاكل لا مفر منها في السجن، مع اقتراب أعمال شغب عرقية. يجب على مايكل الحصول على مسمار من المدرجات لإنهاء عمله، لكنه يحتاج إلى مساعدة من مصدر غير متوقع.

3.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى اختبار ولاء زميله في الزنزانة، سوكري، لمعرفة ما إذا كان يمكن الوثوق به في خطة الهروب. في هذه الأثناء، يقع ابن لينكون، إل جي، في مشكلة.

4.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى إيجاد مادة كيميائية ستأكل الأنابيب. كما يحتاج إلى التخلص من زميله في الزنزانة، سوكري، الذي يعيق خططه.

5.o: يجب على مايكل الاختيار بين ثلاثة طرق مختلفة للهروب. في هذه الأثناء، يتم تقديم موعد إعدام لينكون، وتحاول فيرونيكا دونوفان العثور على أدلة لإثبات براءته.

6.ar: أعمال شغب، تدريبات والشيطان: الجزء الأول
6.o: تندلع أعمال شغب في السجن، ويجب على مايكل استخدام الفوضى لصالحه للوصول إلى المستوصف. في هذه الأثناء، تُحاصر الدكتورة سارة تانكريدي في وسط أعمال الشغب.

7.ar: أعمال شغب، تدريبات والشيطان: الجزء الثاني
7.o: تستمر أعمال الشغب، ويجب على مايكل الوصول إلى المستوصف للحصول على آخر قطعة من وشمته. في هذه الأثناء، لينكون في خطر، وتحاول فيرونيكا الحصول على مساعدة من صديق قديم.

8.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى الحصول على عنصر معين من مكتب الرأس القديم، لكنه محاط بسجين خطير. في هذه الأثناء، يتم رفض استئناف لينكون، ويفقد الأمل.

9.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى زميل جديد في الزنزانة، لكنه ينتهي به المطاف مع سجين شاب مزعج يدعى توينر. في هذه الأثناء، يلحق ماضي أبروزي به، ويفقد السيطرة.

10.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى الحصول على عنصر معين من مخزن السجن، لكنه يحتاج إلى مساعدة من سجين جديد. في هذه الأثناء، تحاول فيرونيكا ونيك سافرين العثور على أدلة لإثبات براءة لينكون.

11.o: خطة الهروب شبه مكتملة، لكن مايكل يحتاج إلى التخلص من سجين آخر. في هذه الأثناء، تجد فيرونيكا ونيك قطعة حاسمة من الأدلة، لكنهما في خطر.

12.o: فريق الهروب يتقلص، ويجب على مايكل اتخاذ قرار صعب بشأن من يتركه وراءه. في هذه الأثناء، تقترب فيرونيكا ونيك من الحقيقة، لكنهما مراقبان.

13.o: فريق الهروب مستعد للتحرك، لكنهم يواجهون عقبة غير متوقعة. في هذه الأثناء، فيرونيكا ونيك في خطر، ويجب عليهما الهروب لإنقاذ حياتهما.

14.o: تأخر الهروب، ويجب على مايكل التعامل مع مشكلة جديدة. في هذه الأثناء، تحاول فيرونيكا ونيك كشف المؤامرة، لكنهما ينفد منهما الوقت.

15.t: By the Skin and the Teeth
15.o: وشم مايكل تالف، ويجب عليه إيجاد طريقة لإصلاحه. في هذه الأثناء، يتم تحديد موعد إعدام لينكون، وتحاول فيرونيكا ونيك الحصول على وقف تنفيذ الإعدام.

16.o: يتم الكشف عن ماضي مايكل ولينكون، وكيف انتهى بهما المطاف في السجن. في هذه الأثناء، يواجه فريق الهروب تحديات جديدة، ويجب عليهم العمل معًا للبقاء على قيد الحياة.

17.o: يوضع مايكل في الحبس الانفرادي، ويجب عليه إيجاد طريقة للخروج. في هذه الأثناء، يحاول فريق الهروب مواصلة الخطة بدونه، لكنهم يواجهون عقبات جديدة.

18.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى الحصول على عنصر معين من مخزن السجن، لكنه يحتاج إلى مساعدة من سجين جديد. في هذه الأثناء، تحاول فيرونيكا ونيك كشف المؤامرة، لكنهما في خطر.

19.o: يحتاج مايكل إلى الحصول على مفتاح من الدكتورة سارة تانكريدي، لكنها تشك فيه. في هذه الأثناء، يواجه فريق الهروب تحديات جديدة، ويجب عليهم العمل معًا للبقاء على قيد الحياة.

20.o: فريق الهروب مستعد للتحرك، لكنهم يواجهون عقبة غير متوقعة. في هذه الأثناء، فيرونيكا ونيك في خطر، ويجب عليهما الهروب لإنقاذ حياتهما.

21.o: يبدأ الفريق الهروب من الحفرة في زنزانة سكوفيلد.

22.o: مع استمرار الهروب، تُفقد الأرواح، ويبذل بوب وبيليك قصارى جهدهما لإيقافهم.

1.o: بعد الهروب من سجن فوكس ريفر، يحاول مايكل ورفاقه الهاربون تجنب القبض عليهم، بينما يبدأ العميل الفدرالي "ماهون" بملاحقتهم ويكتشف أن وشوم مايكل تحمل أدلة مخفية. في الوقت نفسه، تُقتل فيرونيكا بعد كشفها حقيقة ستيدمان، ويبدأ ماهون في تحليل الوشوم لفهم خطة الهاربين.

2.o: يعقد ماهون صفقة مع "إل.جي" لاستخدامه كطعم للإيقاع بمايكل ولينكون، لكن الأخوين يقرران تنفيذ عملية جريئة لإنقاذه من سجن المقاطعة، إلا أن ماهون يشرف على حراسته بشكل مباشر.

3.o: يبحث مايكل عن سيارته التي تم سحبها بينما تزداد ملاحقة ماهون له بعد استعادة حقيبته وجواز سفره. سوكري يتوجه إلى نيويورك لإيقاف زواج ماريكروز، وسارة تقرر دخول مركز إعادة التأهيل، بينما بيليك وجيري يبدأان بمطاردة مايكل من أجل المكافأة.

4.o: يتم القبض على مايكل ولينكون ونيكا من قبل بيليك وجيري اللذين يريدان الحصول على أموال ويستمورلاند. أبروزي يزور عائلته ويقرر إنهاء حسابه مع فيبروناتشي أولاً، بينما يكمل ماهون بحثه بعد الاشتباه بأن الإخوة قد قُتلوا في انفجار.

5.o: يصل مايكل ولينكون إلى تويلي ولكن ينقصهما خريطة تحدد موقع الأموال، وهناك يلتقون تي-باغ وتوينر. سوكري يصل إلى لاس فيغاس لمحاولة منع الزفاف، وسارة تزداد ثقتها بـ "كيلرمان" الذي يقترب منها تحت اسم مستعار.

6.o: تتقدم خطة البحث مع وصول ماهون إلى سولت ليك سيتي، بينما يبدأ مايكل التعاون مؤقتاً مع تي-باغ وتوينر للوصول إلى الأموال. في الوقت ذاته، يبدأ سوكري وسي-نوت التحرك نحو تويلي، ويزداد قلق سارة بعد تلقي تحذير من والدها.

7.o: تتعطل خطة الهاربين عندما تصل ابنة صاحب المنزل وهي شرطية، في حين يحاول ماهون الضغط على توينر للحصول على معلومات. سارة تبدأ بالشك في كيلرمان، ويخطط لينكون لاصطحاب إل.جي بعد اقتراب الإفراج عنه.

8.o: يسعى سوكري إلى أخذ نصيبه من المال لكنه يواجه مشاكل غير متوقعة، وبيليك وشريكه لا يزالان مستمرين في مطاردة الهاربين على أمل الحصول على المكافأة.

9.o: يحاول مايكل الحصول على عنصر من حديقة نباتية لكنه يكتشف أن ماهون سبقه. يبدأ مايكل التحقيق في ماضي ماهون، بينما يسافر إلى كولورادو لمقابلة امرأة لها علاقة بما يجري. سارة تحاول فك رموز الأوراق التي تركها لها مايكل.

10.o: يعذب بيليك تي-باغ للحصول على المفتاح، بينما تلتقي سارة بمايكل ويهربان بصعوبة من ماهون. لينكون وإل.جي يتم إنقاذهما من قبل والد لينكون، لكن الخطر لا يزال يلاحقهما.

11.o: يصل مايكل إلى نيو مكسيكو للحصول على المعدات اللازمة لكنه يتردد في استكمال خطته. تي-باغ ينجو من الشرطة لكنه يضطر للتخلي عن يده الصناعية. يصل الإخوة الثلاثة إلى كولورادو ويخططون للخطوة التالية.

12.o: استكمالًا من حيث توقفنا، سوكري، مايكل، لينك، وألدو معًا، وماهون يلاحقهم. سارة ملقاة على وجهها في حوض الاستحمام بينما يستعد كيلرمان للتخلص من جثتها. سي-نوت في هارفي، نورث داكوتا مع كاسي وديدي، التي تحتاج إلى دوائها. في تريبيون، كانساس، يستجوب المحقق سلاتري بيليك.

13.o: يعتقل حرس الحدود مايكل ولينكون، قائلين لهما إن ماهون يدعي أن حياته حظ سيء. يعبر سوكري الحدود ويقفز بالمظلة في صحراء سونورا في المكسيك. يذهب تي-باغ إلى حانة قدامى المحاربين في برات، كانساس، ويسرق طرفًا صناعيًا من رقيب مخضرم.

14.o: قرر لينك ومايكل أخذ المفاتيح والهروب، معتقدين أنهما سيقاتلان حتى النهاية. طاردهم العميل الخاص لمكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي ألكسندر ماهون بينما كان على اتصال بالعميل الخاص للخدمة السرية بول كيلرمان الذي أطلق النار فجأة على ماهون وأعطى الأخوين فرصة لأنه يريد معرفة ما يدور في البيت الأبيض. لينك يريد أن يكون أخوه آمنًا.

15.o: في كاتباك، مونتانا، يستدرج كيلرمان الشرطة ويختطف مايكل ولينكون المصور غريغ من فوكس نيوز وينجحان في الهروب من الحصار. يقرر مايكل ولينكون تسجيل رسالة ليتم بثها في الأخبار العاجلة. يعود ماهون إلى شيكاغو ويحلل الرسالة؛ يستجوب غريغ ويخبره أنه سمع مايكل.

16.o: تلتقي سارة بمايكل ولينكون في محطة قطار في إيفانسفيل، إنديانا؛ عندما ترى كيلرمان معهما، تصبح مضطربة ومنزعجة. يخبر كيلرمان أن لديه مفتاح نادي سيجار خاص في شيكاغو. تتصل كارولين بكيلرمان ويخبرها أنه يتجه إلى شيكاغو بالقطار، وتعده بإعادة حياته الطبيعية، بما في ذلك منصب رئيس الأركان. يستعيد تي-باغ حياته الطبيعية.

17.o: يفشل مايكل سكوفيلد وسارة تانكريدي في الحصول على الشريط من نادي سيجار كورونا دي أورو في شيكاغو، حيث كانت الأمن في حالة تأهب، ويلجآن إلى المدير السابق هنري بوب، وهو عضو في النادي، لكنه يريد الاتصال بالشرطة. يسحب مايكل مسدسه ويسلمه لإثبات صدقه. تقنعه سارة بمفتاح والدها الراحل الخاص بالمرطب ويجد مقصورة سرية.

18.o: يدخل الكابتن براد بيليك مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي مطالبًا ماهون بدفع مستحقاته. ينبهر مايكل ورفاقه بالتسجيلات الموجودة على العصا، لكنها لا تساعد إلا إذا استخدمت اتصالات كيلرمان في واشنطن بشكل صحيح، ولا سيما مسؤول العدل الكبير كوبر غرين، الذي يوافق على الاجتماع والتعاون، لكنه يرفض إعطاء الشريط. يتصل مايكل بفتى. يرفض لينك إعطاء الشريط. سي-نوت في شيكاغو، وتحاول العميلة لانغ استخدام زوجته للقبض عليه.

19.o: قفز سي-نوت بالحبل حول رقبته، لكن حراس السجن أنقذوه؛ أخبره ماهون أنه سيفعل ذلك. في فندق في شيكاغو، من المتوقع أن تلقي الرئيسة كارولين رينولدز خطابًا. يرسل مايكل كوبر غرين الحقيقي بعيدًا ويوافق على نقطة التقاء مع لينك وسارة. يدخل ماهون غرفة سارة، لكنه يتظاهر فقط بالفشل في البحث تحت السرير للإيقاع بها.

20.o: بعد أن استقالت كارولين رينولدز من منصبها كرئيسة، لم يعد بإمكانها التوقيع على عفو، لذا يجب على الأخوين الاختفاء فورًا وإلى الأبد. في الرصيف، تدرك سارة أنها تتعرض للمراقبة وتتظاهر على الهاتف بأنها على متن السفينة بالفعل، لذا تبحر بدونها بينما يتم القبض عليها. يوقف لينكون عودتها. بعد أسبوع، يتم العثور على مسؤول كبير في مكتب التحقيقات الفيدرالي ميتًا.

21.o: مايكل في سونا، ويجب عليه إيجاد طريقة للهروب. يحاول لينكون مساعدته من الخارج، لكنه أيضًا في خطر. ماهون لا يزال يطاردهم، والشركة لا تزال تحاول الإمساك بهم. سارة أيضًا تحاول المساعدة، لكنها في خطر أيضًا. ينتهي الموسم ومايكل لا يزال في سونا، ولينكون يحاول إيجاد طريقة لإخراجه.

22.o: مايكل ولينكون في بنما، لكنهما ليسا آمنين. يتم مطاردتهما من قبل ماهون والشركة. يتم القبض على مايكل وإرساله إلى سونا، وهو سجن بنمي يديره السجناء. لينكون لا يزال حرًا، لكنه في خطر. سارة أيضًا في خطر، وهي هاربة.

1.o: مايكل يُرسل إلى سجن "سونا" الذي يديره السجناء بأنفسهم. يُجبر على الخضوع لقوانين البقاء فيه ويتلقى إنذارًا من "الشركة" عبر لينكون: إذا لم يُخرّج ويسلر، ستُقتل سارة و إل-جاي.

2.o: يشعر مايكل بالضغط لإنقاذ ويسلر، وينزل إلى المجاري للبحث عنه. في السجن، تحدث اضطرابات بسبب انقطاع المياه، مما يُسهّل خطوته. في الخارج، لينكون يتلقى أوامر جديدة من "الشركة"

3.o: مايكل يسعى للحصول على هاتف داخل السجن للتواصل مع سارة، بينما لينكون يحاول فهم ما ترمز إليه سارة في صورة أرسلتها. شراكة متوترة تبدأ بينه وبين ماهون.

4.o: مشاهد من الخطط الخارجية والغموض تتداخل مع حياة مايكل داخل سونا؛ الصراع على الثقة بين مايكل ولايتشيرو يأخذ منحى جديد.

5.o: يدخل سجين جديد يُدعى تايج، يدعي معرفة ويسلر. مايكل يراقب الحراس بعناية، بينما يضع لينكون خطة هروب جديدة بتوقيت دقيق.

6.o: صورة تحفز لينكون وتجعله متردّدًا، بينما مايكل يُواجه اتهامات بمحاولة قتل سجين. التوتر يزداد وكذلك التحالفات داخل سونا.

7.o: تبدأ عملية الهروب من سونا من خلال اكتشاف نفق سرّي يُمكِّنهم من المغادرة، مما يُعيد الأمل لبقية السجناء.

8.o: يتعرّض "ليتشيرو" لإعادة ترتيب في قوّة السجن، وتزداد خطة الهروب تعقيدًا. اشتعال التوتر بين السجناء يقود المواجهة الكبرى.

9.o: توتر وتضييق على المساحة المُتاحة للهروب. مايكل يواجه ظروفًا محكمة في سونا، ولينكون يحاول التضييق على الخاطفين.

10.o: تتعقد الأوضاع داخل سونا، حيث يُجبر الشهود أو الرافضون على دفع الثمن، أما مايكل فيسعى للحيلولة دون فشل النهاية.

11.o: تستمر محاولات التسلل والخروج وسط ضغط كبير، وماهون ينفّذ دورًا غامضًا ضمن اللعبة.

12.o: المواجهات تبلغ ذروتها، والمخاطر لا تعرف هوادة. القرار الحاسم يقترب، والوقت يداهم الجميع.

13.o: المواجهة النهائية في بنما بين مايكل ولينكون في مواجهة ويستلر وجرتشن. يحدث تبادل ناجح، وسقوط كارثي لليتشيرو وسط فوضى سونا. النهاية تفتح الباب لانتقال درامي نحو الموسم القادم.

1.o: لينكون يكتشف أن مايكل ما زال حيًا ومحتجزًا في سجن أوجيجيا باليمن، ويبدأ التخطيط لإنقاذه.

2.o: مايكل يعيش بهوية جديدة داخل السجن. لينكون وسوكري يصلان إلى اليمن لمساعدته، لكن الأوضاع الأمنية تسوء.

3.o: مايكل ينفذ خطة للهروب، بينما سارة في أمريكا تتعرض لتهديد من عملاء الشركة السابقين.

4.o: الفريق يواجه فوضى عارمة داخل السجن مع اندلاع الشغب، وخطة الهروب تصل إلى لحظاتها الحاسمة.

5.o: بعد الخروج من السجن، مايكل وفريقه يفرون عبر اليمن بينما الحرب تشتد، وتبدأ المطاردة.

6.o: مايكل والفريق يعبرون الصحراء للوصول إلى ملاذ آمن، لكنهم يطاردون من قبل مرتزقة مسلحين.

7.o: الهروب عبر البحر يتعطل بسبب ملاحقة الأعداء، ومايكل يكشف خطة بديلة للوصول إلى أمريكا.

12.o: تستعد "كارول" و"بارب" للحرب، وتقابل "ليندا" السجينات لأجل فيديو علاقات عامة للسجن، وتعقد "آليكس" صفقة مع "باديسون" لتبعد المتاعب عن "بايبر".

13.o: تصل أنباء مفاجئة إلى "بايبر" ودعم من صديقاتها، فيما تعود هيئة المُحلّفين بحكمها، وتنعقد مباراة كرة قدم كبرى.

1.o: تعاني "بايبر" في التكيّف مع الحياة بعدما نالت حرّيتها، وتعِد "آليكس" بتجنّب المشاكل، فيما تغضب "دايا" من خيانة "دادي".

2.o: تكسب "بايبر" قوت يومها من مجالسة طفلة، وتحثّ "أليدا" "هوبر" على السعي لترقية، وتتوتر "آليكس" بسبب عمليات تفتيش عشوائية وتحصل "دايا" على عرض.

3.t: And Brown Is the New Orange
3.o: تهبّ رياح التغيير مع قدوم آمرة السجن الجديدة، وتجتمع "بلانكا" بصديقة قديمة مجدّدًا، وتحاول "سوزان" إصلاح العلاقة بين "تايستي" و"بلاك سيندي".

4.o: تعمل "بايبر" لدى والدها، ويزور "فيني" "لورنا" حاملًا خبرًا، وتطلب "تايستي" اليائسة معروفًا من "دايا"، ويُحاضر "كابوتو" عن العدالة التصحيحية.

5.o: تحاول "أليدا" الحفاظ على ابنتها المراهقة، فيما تلقي "بايبر" و"كال" عن كاهلهما عبء مسؤولياتهما ليوم، وتتعامل "بلانكا" مع النظام القضائي.

6.o: تستفيد "تايستي" من وضعها الجديد وتُعلّم "ليندا" "تاميكا" فنّ المراوغة، فيما تعتذر "بلاك سيندي" و"ماريا" للأشخاص الذين عانوا من أذيّتهما.

7.o: تُقِيم "بايبر" علاقات عابرة، ويحاول "كابوتو" منع فضيحة. أمّا "دايا"، فتُكلّف "تايستي" بمهمّة، وتجد "نيكي" الحبّ.

8.o: تصطحب "نيري" "بايبر" لخلوة في البرّية وتعلّم "تايستي" "بينساتوكي"، وتتعامل "سوزان" مع مشكلة قنّ الدجاج وتدور محادثة عصيبة بين "نيكي" و"رد".

9.o: تجبر المنافسة "دايا" على إيجاد مُهرّب جديد، وتقرّر "بايبر" التصريح بأنها كانت سجينة، وتطلب "كارلا" حضور جلسة وصاية وتخبر "شاني" "نيكي" بسرّ.

10.o: تُعيد "بايبر" التواصل مع شخصين من ماضيها، فيما تتأمّل "آليكس" ماضيها العاطفي، وتُنذر "ليندا" "تاميكا"، ويعترف "كابوتو" بأفعاله السيّئة.

11.o: تسعى "ماريا" للتصالح مع "غلوريا" وتترافع "كارلا" و"بلانكا" في قضيتيهما وتواجه "فيغيروا" "ليتفاك" وتشارك "بايبر" في حفل جمع تبرعات مع "زلدا".

12.o: تقابل "تايستي" محامية. ومع اقتراب موعد امتحان التعليم العام، تحفّز "سوزان" "بينساتوكي"، وتقع "غلوريا" في مأزق، فيما تواجه "آليكس" "بايبر".

13.o: في هذه الحلقة الأخيرة من المسلسل، نرى صورًا من الوداع المليء بالدموع وتكريمات جيّاشة وبدايات جديدة... وداعًا نساء "ليتشفيلد"!

1.o: Mr. Bean attends a mathematics exam, where he tries to copy from a student under the nose of the invigilator, when he realizes that he has studied the wrong maths equations. Afterwards, he surreptitiously changes into his swimming trunks so as not to be noticed by someone sitting nearby at a beach. And later struggles to stay awake during a church service and obnoxiously sings the refrain of the hymn "All Creatures of Our God and King," much to the annoyance of the man sitting next to him, Mr. Sprout.

2.o: Mr. Bean goes to a department store and buys various items. Afterwards, he goes to a fancy restaurant where he tries to dispose his awful-tasting meal. And finally, Bean goes to a Royal greeting and gets into mischief.

3.o: Mr. Bean goes to a swimming pool, where he finds himself scared to death on the high diving board. When he's done, he tries several different ways to get his car out of the parking garage after he realizes he doesn't have enough money to do it the normal way. After that, he sits on a park bench and uses an unusual method of making himself a sandwich. Finally, he goes to a cinema and tries to survive a terrifying horror movie with his girlfriend.

4.o: Mr. Bean purchases a new TV, only to experience a spot of reception trouble. He then takes a stroll in the park to try out his new camera, which is promptly stolen. This leads to an identity parade, where Bean does his best to discover the identity of the camera thief. Later, Bean's night on the town spells disaster for a stage magician. Lastly, Mr. Bean shows off his dancing skills at Club Phut.

5.o: Mr. Bean, late for his dental appointment, tries to get dressed and clean his teeth whilst on the way. After arriving just in time for the appointment, he ends up administering an anesthetic to the hapless dentist. After visiting the dentist, Bean has a picnic in the park, where he tangles with a pesky fly and a remote-control toy boat.

6.o: At the bus stop, Mr. Bean tries his best to revive a heart attack victim before using an ambulance to jump-start his own mini-car. Later, when posting a letter, he loses his only stamp, but that doesn't stop him from sending his letter anyway. Whilst preparing for his holiday, Mr. Bean demonstrates a novel (if not entirely efficient) method of packing, then disposes of a bothersome train passenger, and tries to entertain an airsick boy during a plane flight.

7.o: While Christmas shopping, Mr. Bean purchases a bulky string of tree lights before making a shambles of a department store toy section. He later manages to acquire a free turkey and Christmas tree, and attempts to conduct a Salvation Army band. Finally, during Christmas dinner, Bean has quite a surprise in store for his long-suffering girlfriend.

8.o: Mr. Bean goes to a hotel where he causes trouble and seeks competition in his hotel neighbor. After he eats some spoiled oysters, he wakes up at night from some loud noise and ends up being locked out of his room.

9.o: On New Year's Eve, Bean hosts his very own party with his friends Rupert and Hubert, but it isn't long before his guests discover that there is more fun at the party next door and trick Bean into letting them go. The following morning on New Year's Day, Bean buys some new tools and a large recliner armchair at the January sales of a department store and has a unique way of driving home. He then tries painting his flat himself and starts off the new year with a bang.

10.o: On his way to the Southsea funfair, Mr. Bean accidentally becomes lumbered with a baby boy with no idea of how or where he came from, forcing him to try having fun at the fair with the baby. Throughout the day, the baby manages to survive Bean's unique style of mishaps before eventually being reunited with his mother.

11.o: Mr. Bean attends an open day of a local school, where he unleashes his usual brand of chaos in the various classes he visits. Afterwards, Bean's day soon takes a sombre turn when he finds that his Mini isn't parked where he left it and is crushed by an Army Tank during the demonstration.

12.o: After causing chaos at the town launderette while having his laundry cleaned, Bean tries his hand at mini golf, but after being told by the course's owner that he can only touch the ball with the club and not with his hands, Bean's poor aim leads him on an elaborate tour around town before ultimately returning to the course several hours later with a final score of 3,427 strokes.

13.o: At a hospital waiting room, Bean uses various methods to skip ahead of the queue but his antics backfire. Later at a park, he decorates Queen's Guard, so that he can take a picture. And at the end of the day, Bean tries to cure his insomnia with some unusual methods at home.

14.t: Hair by Mr. Bean of London
14.o: At a barbershop, Mr. Bean inadvertently holds the fort for the barber when he is distracted by a phonecall, resulting in him giving several customers terrible haircuts. Later, Bean heads to a fête, where he cheats at all the games and enters Teddy into a children's pet show, where his inanimacy allows Bean to pass all the obedience tests with flying colours. And finally, after a train journey, Bean accidentally loses his ticket and unsuccessfully tries to sneak out past the station's guard inside a mail bag.

1.o: عندما تعرف أم جمعة أنه يضع ماله في الفلوكة، طلبت منه أن يأخذ فاطمة ويذهب ويعطيها لها، لكن عندما ذهبا قامت إسرائيل بغارة على القناة تسببت في حرق الفلوكة بما فيها كما تسببت في إصابة فاطمة في رأسها وتسببت في إصابتها بالعمى، يتزوج جمعة فاطمة، ثم يهاجر مع أسرته من السويس مثل باقي الأسر، يعمل جمعة في جلب شاي وسكر لأحد المقاهي لكن مباحث التموين أمسكت بالشاي والسكر بعدما رفض المعلم أخذها بسبب مواقف مصطفى.

2.o: يتفق جمعة مع والدته وفاطمة على أن يسافر لكي يحصل على ماله من الخواجة بانداليدس، يذهب الأستاذ لسالم ويخبره أن جمعة أصبح مفلس ويريد السفر لليونان لأخذ ماله من خواجة، فيوهمه الأستاذ بمشروع شركة سياحية، ثم يعطيه 50 جنيه ليسافر لليونان، وهناك يقابله الريس زكريا، يطلب إبراهام من ديموس أن يصاحب جمعة، يتصل ديموس بجمعة ويعزمه على الطعام، يتحدث زكريا مع جمعة عن البحث عن عمل لأنه لن يتمكن من إيجاد بانداليدس.

3.o: يذهب الضابط ويقبض على جمعة كما طلب منه إبراهام بعدما جعل ديموس يأخذ جواز سفر جمعة ليجدده، وبعد 3 أيام ذهب وأخرجه من السجن، يبيع جمعة ساعته لزكريا، ويقرر العودة لمصر، يذهب ديموس ويخبر جمعة أن بانداليدس وصل فذهب له، لكنه أخبره أن عمله متوقف ولا يوجد معه مال، لكنه وجد له عمل على مركبة، يرسل جمعة خطاب لفاطمة ووالدته قرأه لهما مصطفى، حيث قال جمعة لهم فيه ما قابله في اليونان، وهو ما جعل فاطمة تحزن.

4.o: تحلم فاطمة حلم سيء عن جمعة وأخبرته لأم جمعة، يطلب إبراهام من ديفيس أن يجعل جمعة يحب جوجو، يطلب جيمي من جوجو قضاء وقت مع جمعة وجعله يحبها ويعرف أنها يهودية، تقابل جوجو جمعة وتشرب معه ويبدأ في التحدث معها عن أسرته عن مصطفى وأمه وفاطمة وإصابتها بالعمى وعن مركبته التي غرقت، وكل هذا كان جيمي وإبراهام يستمع له، يعود مصطفى للمنزل وهو مصاب في رأسه والدم ينزف منه، فزاد شعور فاطمة بالحزن بسبب غياب جمعة.

5.o: تضع جوجو قرص في كأس جمعة ويبدو أنه كان منوم وبعد ذلك تأخذه لفندق وتعطيه 100 جنيه وأخبرته أنها ستجعله يقابل والدها ليجد له عمل، ثم تحدثت معه عن كره المصريين لليهود، يقرر مصطفى أخذ حقه من الذين ضربوه، لكنه فشل في ذلك ولكن المعلم أعجب به وأخبره أنه سيعطيه 150 جنيه و10% من العمل الذي سيأتي به، تطلب جوجو من جمعة أن يترك عمله على المركب، يطلب جيمي من جوجو عدم مقابلة جمعة لمدة يومين ثم ذهبت له في الثالث.

6.o: يعاتب جمعة جوجو على تغيبها عنه لمدة 3 أيام، فحزنت وبكت وخرجت من عنده، فذهب ورائها وأخبرها أنه يحبها فقالت له أنها تحبه، وأخبرته بميعاده مع والدها ديفيس لكي يجعله يعمل، وﻷنها أخبرته أنها ستتزوجه، يذهب جمعة لشركة ديفيس وهناك يقابله ثم يطلب منه حسن سوكة أن يكتب كل شيء عن حياته وكل ما يخصه ويخص أقاربه حتى يتم وضعه في وظيفة مناسبة له، تقول جوجو لجيمي أنها لن تجعل جمعة يسافر فجعل ميري تعطيها حقنة منوم.

7.o: يذهب حسن ويدفع حساب الفندق الذي نزل فيه جمعة، ثم طلب منه عمل عملية لصالح ديفيس مقابل 500 جنيه إسترليني بشرط السرية التامة، وأخبره بأن يأتي بالمعلومات ثم يسافر لدولة أجنبية ويرسل على عنوان أنه متواجد بالدولة ويوقع باسم أحمد عبدالرحمن، يعود جمعة لتنفيذ عمله، تشك فاطمة في جمعة بسبب المال الذي عاد به، وأنه قابل فتاة في أوروبا، يذهب جمعة لمقر المخابرات المصرية، وهناك وجد الريس زكريا، وحكى له كل ما حدث.

8.o: يطلب زكريا من جمعة كتابة كل شيء حدث معه ﻷن ذلك قد يجعله يتذكر أشياء قد تكون مهمة، يطلب زكريا من جمعة ألا يخبر أحد بأنه جاء إليه، ثم أعطاه الساعة وأخبره أن يذهب للطبيب بفاطمة ولا يدفع شيء، يوافق جمعة على العمل مع المعلم برعي ولكن بطريقته هو، يطلب زكريا من جمعة السفر وإخبار سوكة بالمعلومات الصحيحة عما طلبه منه عن المركب، يطلب الطبيب من فاطمة الالتزام بالدواء حتى يحدد ميعاد عملية لها.

9.o: يتم القبض على شبكة الدكتور والأستاذ، يبدأ رواد المقهى والمعلم في التحدث عن أن جمعة قد يكون متعاون مع الأستاذ، وهو ما جعل مصطفى يتضايق، يتصل شخص بجمعة ويطلب منه السفر لميلانو عبر القطار ليقابل جاك، وعندما يدخل غرفة الفندق وجد جاك في الغرفة وأخبره بكل المعلومات التي طلبوها منه، وعندما سأله عن قاعدة الصواريخ قال له جمعة أنه يفضل بيع المعلومات لدولة وليس شركة، فقال له جاك أنه ضابط إسرائيلي.

10.o: يخبر أبو داوود جمعة بأنه سيرسل له المعلومات بالكربون السري ثم أعطاه مال بعد تدريب لمدة 15 يوم وطلب منه إحضار معلومات عن الجيش المصري، بعدما تأكد من قاعدة الصواريخ وقامت إسرائيل بضربها، يخاف زكريا على جمعة فيذهب له فيطمئن جمعة عندما يراه، يعود جمعة لمصر ويحكي لزكريا كل ما حدث معه، فطلب منه شراء شقة وفتح محل بقالة كما طلب منه أبو داوود، يعاتب أبو أشرف مصطفى على نزول جمعة للسويس دون المجيء له.

11.o: يتحدث مصطفى مع والدته عما يقوله الناس عن جمعة وعن مصدر أمواله، يرى مصطفى جمعة وهو يتحدث مع أحد أفراد الجيش، وعندما كذب عليه جمعة، واجهه بما قاله أبو أشرف، يبلغ مصطفى المخابرات المصرية عن جمعة، لكن زكريا أخبره أن جمعة لديه شركة سياحة ويحضر لها أفواج، ثم ذهب ليقابل جمعة في شقة الفلكي، يطلب زكريا من جمعة عدم السفر للمرة الثانية كما طلب منه الإسرائيليين ﻷن لديه موعد مع طبيب للعيون من أجل عملية فاطمة.

12.o: يعتذر جمعة لمصطفى ويأخذه في حضنه بعدما ضربه بسبب تغيبه عن المحل، تجري فاطمة عملية ناجحة في عينها، يطلب زكريا من جمعة عدم الرد على جوابات الإسرائيليين خلال مدة سفره، تعبر مصر القناة ويفرح جمعة وباقي المصريين بذلك، يعود زكريا ويخبر جمعة أنه يريد منه السفر لتل أبيب بعد التدرب على جهاز كشف الكذب ﻷنه بذلك سيحصل لمصر على جهاز لاسلكي متقدم جدًا، يتحدث جيمي مع جوجو على رغبته في أن تذهب لجمعة في مصر.

13.o: يفرح جمعة بأن فاطمة حامل، ورغم ذلك ذهب لزكريا وأخبره أنه موافق على السفر، فقم بتدريبه على جهاز كشف الكذب، يعطي جمعة لفاطمة جواب ويطلب منها عدم فتحه إلا بعد مرور شهرين من عدم عودته من السفر، يسافر جمعة لروما ويطلب منه أبو داوود السفر لإسرائيل، وأعطاه جواز سفر باسم يعقوب، وعندما وصل تل أبيب وجد جوجو هناك، لكن كل هذه الترتيبات جعلت زكريا يقلق حتى أنه وضع خطة لإعادة جمعة لمصر.

14.o: يذهب داني لجمعة ويتحدث معه عما حدث قبل الحرب وعن عملية فاطمة، ثم طلب منه أخذ جهاز لاسلكي لإرسال معلومات منه لهم لكنه رفض ﻷنه خائف وطلب منه أن يستقيل من العمل معهم، تضع جوجو رسالة من زكريا لجمعة في بدلته قبل ذهابه لجهاز كشف الكذب، يتمكن جمعة من تخطي جهاز كشف الكذب، فيعطيه له داني بجانب ساعة هدية، يعود جمعة لمصر ومعه الجهاز ثم يرسل منه رسالة لإسرائيل تقول: من المخابرات المصرية شكرا على تعاونكم معنا.

2.t: The Hero Stays at the Devil's Castle for Work Reasons

3.t: The Devil Goes on a Date with His Junior in Shinjuku
3.o: Something supernatural seems to be going on with Chiho. Meanwhile, it's possible Maou seems to have a difficult time understanding certain concepts.

5.o: Lucifer is wrecking the neighborhood in a big way and he's brought along some unexpected friends! Meanwhile, Emi, Maou, and Ashiya do the impossible and try to work together!

7.o: Maou and company find that a young lady named Suzuno has moved in next door. She is quick to make friends but Emi wonders what her motives are.

8.o: Big problems arise when when a new fast-food restaurant opens up. Meanwhile Emi and Suzuno have many miscommunication problems.

9.o: Maou tries to handle the loss of business caused by the opening of a new restaurant. Meanwhile Emi and Suzuno need an impartial third party to resolve their dispute.

10.t: The Devil and the Hero Take a Break from the Daily Routine
10.o: It's a busy day at the local amusement park, with crowded restaurants, animals on the loose, scary ghosts, and a much-needed swimwear intervention. Meanwhile, Suzuno feels the presence of a white-winged being watching her.

11.t: The Hero Stays True to Her Convictions
11.o: An encounter with a stranger has Suzuno reconsidering her position on the Devil. Meanwhile, Yusa begins stalking Sadao and Shiro around town and learns that they are living good, humble lives.

12.t: The Devil Carries Out His Duties
12.o: The archangel Sariel is willing to torture people to get what he wants. Soon, Satan and Sariel engage in an aerial battle that destroys half of the city.

13.t: The Devil and the Hero Do Some Honest Hard Work
13.o: Ashiya has something he needs to talk to his master about in private. Meanwhile, Emi also has a strange dream where Satan conquers Sasakuza.

2.t: The Devil and the Hero Inconceivably Become Parents
2.o: Alas Ramus seems dead set on the idea that Maou and Emi are her parents. 3.t: The Devil and the Hero Go to the Amusement Park as Advised
3.o: Maou, Emi, and Alas Ramus have an eventful day at the amusement park. Meanwhile, their three stalkers do their not-so-great best to blend in.

4.t: The Devil Learns the Pain of Losing Something Precious
4.o: Emi attends a sleepover at the Devil's Castle. But in the morning, the fight for Alas Ramus and the sacred sword begins. Will Maou and Emi win? Will Gabriel take what's precious? Will there be a magical girl transformation sequence?!

5.t: The Devil Is at Sea After Losing His Home and His Job
5.o: Alas Ramus may be safe, but Maou and his roommates have a few more crises to face. Luckily, they have strong allies on their side.

6.t: The Hero Helps the Devil Reequip His Workplace
6.o: With Ohguro's new and improved look, business is booming! In fact, there are more customers than Maou and his team can handle alone. And at night, there are ominous shadows in the fog...

7.t: The Devil Learns That Choshi (and the World) Are Bigger Than He Knew
7.o: Emi, Maou, and the gang learn the source of the recent demon invasion, as well as some surprising facts about Choshi City and their boss.

8.o: Maou, Ashiya, and Urushihara get a farming job on Chiho's recommendation. Emi seems to have some feelings about it.

9.t: The Devil and the Hero Rise Up to Defend the Sasakis
9.o: Thieves and demons and bears, oh my!

10.t: The Devil Adamantly Insists on Buying a TV
10.o: Maou thirsts for a TV, Emi learns some shocking news, and Urushihara schools us all on how to be proper NEETs.

11.o: Buying the Devil's TV is more exciting than anyone expected. Unrelatedly, Maou is wiser about human relationships than anyone expected.

12.t: The Devil and the Hero Focus on What's Happening Right Now
12.o: The whole gang prepares for their showdown with Raguel. But the fight has a lot of unexpected twists and turns, thanks to meddling from more than one immortal.

13.t: The Devil Returns to the Workplace
13.o: The Sasazuka MgRonald's remodeling is complete. New toilets! Better coffee machines! Maou and Ashiya's worries would be over, if it weren't for the girls' suspicious new habit.

14.t: The Devil and the Hero Question Their Daily Routine
14.o: The battle with Gabriel and Raguel is over, but the transition back into daily life isn't all smooth sailing.

15.t: The Devil and the Hero Take the First Steps toward a New Dream
15.o: Maou has been thinking about dreams ever since his conversation with Kisaki, and he knows exactly what to do next. Of course, whether he can get the necessary parties' buy-in on his dream is another matter...

16.t: The Devil and the Hero Go Futon Shopping
16.o: Alas Ramus deserves a safe and comfy place to sleep! Emi and Maou go on a futon-shopping quest while Ashiya and Urushihara try to figure out what's going on with Suzuno.

17.t: The Hero Says Goodbye for a Time
17.o: Emi takes a trip to Ente Isla. Those left behind in Japan spend a lot of time arguing about whether or not they're worried.

18.t: The Devil Gets Off to a Late Start
18.o: Urushihara and Suzuno rush to Chiho's aid, but Maou lags behind thanks to his lack of magic and his confusing new acquaintances. Meanwhile, Ashiya has the toughest job of all: explaining all this to Rika.

19.o: Who's holding Emi hostage? Why are so many humans, demons, and angels after Ashiya? Maou needs to find out all this and more, but first he needs a new source of power to defeat the invading army with.

20.o: Emi is freshly struck by all the differences between Ente Isla and Japan. Then Alas Ramus reveals more about herself, causing Emi to reevaluate several things. Meanwhile, Maou is just trying to coexist with Acieth Alla without losing his mind.

21.o: Maou and Suzuno make their way through Ente Isla's forests. Emi and Ashiya each learn what they've been brought to Efzahan for.

22.o: Are we about to finally learn the landlady's secret?! Also, Ashiya takes control of the Malebranche while Maou struggles with his magic and Emi struggles with the stress of her position.

23.t: The Hero Dances on the Battlefield
23.o: Suzuno and Albert's plan hits a snag, but Emi and Ashiya's plans are going oddly well. The big questions of the day are: Can Maou merge with Acieth again? And does he have enough gas left in Powered Dullahan III?

24.t: The Devil and the Hero Witness Change in Ente Isla
24.o: At last, all the players are in place for the final battle in Efzahan. What happens next?

1.o: Sakura Mamiya is a high school student who can see spirits. Her seat in class is next to Rinne Rokudo, who for some reason, most people can see only sometimes. Sakura's friend is troubled by a series of bizarre phone calls. Sakura and Rinne investigate.

2.o: The people at school have a dream about being approached by a woman in a kimono in a strange world with a with a red ring, imploring them to make an offering to the instrument shelter.

3.o: A huge, monstrous cat attacks from the sky. To Sakura's shock, her friends Miho and Rika can see it, too.

4.t: If You Don't Mind Starting as Friends
4.o: The sun of a family of exorcists, Tsubasa Jumonji, has come to school. Right off the bat, he asks out his first love, Sakura! This bothers Rinne, but he turns a cold shoulder towards Sakura.

5.o: Being broke, Rinne is overjoyed about a job Rokumon brought him: to hunt down an evil spirit for 100,000 yen. Meanwhile, something ghostly is going on at school.

6.o: On her way home from school, Sakura hears the voice of a child asking from help from a roadside shrine. She wants to talk to Rinne about it, but Rinne is busy helping mummy-like Taro.

7.o: Sakura spots the spirit of a boy who'd rammed his head into a lamp post be taken away by a boy with bat wings. The next morning, Rinne and Sakura receive a bizarre request letter, but Suzu and Tomoya, who'd also been called there.

8.o: In an effort to rescue Reiji's living spirit, Rinne chases Masato to Hell, where right off the bat he's forced to enter illegally, as he can't pay for the admission fee.

9.t: The Wig's Disappointment and the Pumpkin's Temptation
9.o: Rinne's school holds their school festival. Rinne works at the cafe with Sakura, when they sense something ominous. Just then, a blonde wig flies at them.

10.o: Rinne has come down with an afterlife strain of the flu. A doctor arrives to treat him, but it turns out that he's a Damashigami.

11.o: Sakura, Rokumon and Tsubasa infiltrate Damashigami Company. In an effort to take down the company, Rinne challenges Sabato to a duel.

12.o: Rika gets 100% on a test using a mechanical pencil that makes her smarter, but an ominous aura comes from the pencil.

13.o: In a daze after having seen Rinne and Ageha holding hands, Sakura accidentally wanders into the Reidou. She's surrounded by Damashigamis, but Rinne saves her at the last second.

14.o: Sakura finds the spirit of an idol by the pool, but she doesn't want to bring it up with Rinne; she's still bothered by what happened between him and Ageha.

15.o: Rinne tries to set things straight with Sakura about Ageha. Every time he tries to talk to her, he gets interrupted. Something odd comes out of the bento box that Ageha gives him.

16.o: Tsubasa invites Sakura to visit a huge tree at the elementary school where they met, but there's something not right about the tree.

17.o: Tsubasa is upset: Rinne keeps getting between him and Sakura. But Masato the devil appears before him, offering what appears to be a solution.

18.o: During her pursuit of the Damashigami, Ageha encounters a Shirushigami named Kain. She goes crying to Rinne after he mocks her and her sister.

19.o: Sakura and the others are trapped in a shed at Kain's home. There they find a suspicious box bearing, but they need Rinne to open it, and he's busy fighting Kain.

20.o: Sakura notices something odd when she gets home: there are spirits passing through her house.

21.o: It's bonus season at the Mortal Census Bureau where Kain works. Kain is tasked with delivering the money, but it gets stolen along the way.

22.o: Ageha goes shopping to prepare for an intimate Christmas with Rinne, but on her way home, she notices an ominous aura coming from an abandoned house.

23.o: When Tsubasa catches a cold, Rinne, Sakura, Rokumon, and Kain pay him a visit.

24.o: The weather turns chilly, signalling the start of the perfect season for ramen.

25.o: Sakura gets an experimental candy which can render her unable to see spirits and immediately tries it out.

1.o: Ageha doesn't get along with her black cat contractor, Oboro. They fight.

2.o: A spirit is unable to pass on, held back by a desire to play tennis in the school tennis club.

3.o: Rinne's shinigami union payments go missing. Shirushigami Kain threatens him with late charges.

4.o: A spirit who passed away in the Showa era returns, causing trouble all around the neighborhood.

5.t: Digging Up Memories, Can I Borrow Cash?, Demon at the Camp Grounds
5.o: Rinne's grandma cleans her house, and digs up some goodies. Rinne's Dad is broke again. A demon tries to take one of Sakura's friends' brothers to Hell.

6.o: Rinne's homestay, Shouma, is quite a handful. Hoping to end his school assignment quickly, he goes after an evil spirit, but the spirit appears elsewhere as a living human being.

7.o: Masato tricks Rinne's homestay, Shouma, into turning spirits evil. Both Rinne and Shouma are in deep trouble.

8.o: A spirit is wandering around the steps of a local shrine. She'd died trying to curse Mamiya and Sakura's homeroom teacher, Suzuki-sensei

9.t: Mikazukido for All Your Scythe Needs
9.o: Rinne's Shinigami Scythe needs sharpening. He's invited to Mikazukido, a scythe smith that goes back generations -- but they kind of suck.

10.o: Rokumon and the other black cats are invited to the celebration of a high-profile black cat before his reincarnation. Meanwhile, Rinne does battle with a hobo moth who threatens to make him even poorer.

11.o: It's summer festival season. Rokudou doesn't have money to spend on such fun. Instead, he investigates rumors of "Dancing People."

12.t: Ghost Boat / Something in the Tunnel / Welcome to Nehan-ya
12.o: Sakura and her friends head to the beach, where they run into Rinne, Ageha, Tsubasa and Rokumon. They investigate a ghost boat, an octopus monster and a section of the beach rumored to be filled with spirits.

13.o: Shima Renge is a new student at school. She has a habit of breaking people's hearts -- possibly on purpose.

14.o: Shima Renge's self-imposed community service work hurts Rinne's weather box business, leaving him terrifyingly poor.

15.o: Mikazukido's Recovery Cream can fix anything -- including cats. There's a spirit in the staff storage at school. The black cats go on a trip hunting for magic mushrooms.

16.o: Ageha tries to break-up Rinne and Sakura with an arsenal of Shinigami tools. Renge gets involved, in an attempt to have it all blow up in Ageha's face.

17.o: Demon Masato gets involved his wings stolen by a mysterious man who seems to be trying to lure Rinne into the Shinigami Elementary School reunion.

18.o: Rokumon enters the Black Cat Ranking Exam in pursuit of a ranked black cat contractor discount. Kain and Ageha also have their black cat contractors join. Calamity ensues.

19.o: Rokumon's plan to get the key to the Shinigami door backfires, but he gets his reward. The exam heats up even more.

20.t: Hot Pot Boss, Demon Type-A, Shinigami Type-B
20.o: Rokumon's plan to get the key to the Shinigami door backfires, but he gets his reward. The exam heats up even more.

21.t: Have My Scarf, Waiting on the Rink
21.o: A bossy evil spirit and a bossy Tsubasa nearly crash an oden party Ageha sets up for Rinne. Masato and Rinne are both sick with afterworld strains of influenza. They engage in a glorious coughing battle.

22.o: Renge does everything in her power -- and then some -- to stop her crush, Shirushigami Kain, from finding out that she's a Damashigami.

23.o: Sakura picks up a scythe that becomes attached to her until she can successfully purify seven spirits.

24.o: Ageha tries to put Rinne on a collar. Rinne's friend from elementary school, Matsugo, is not amused. Sakura, on the other hand, sees an opportunity.

25.o: At their faux date, Sakura overhears Rinne saying he likes her because she feeds him and lends him money. He tries to clear things up with her, but Matsugo has his own ideas.

1.o: When Sabato gets caught distributing fake Shinigami Gold licenses, Rinne discovers that his father might have been a genius Shinigami in high school!

2.o: A ghost hand seems to have a grudge against a member of the track team. Later, Sakura discovers a mysterious female spirit who demands art students to draw her face.

3.t: Wheel of Reincarnation Cleanup Day / Infinite Malice / A Puppy in the Rain
3.o: Rinne and the other Shinigami are tasked with cleaning the Wheel of Reincarnation. The dangerous work only gets worse when a brawl breaks out, and Damashigami enter the scene.

4.o: Sakura meets a fortune teller who illegally possesses a Shinigami tool. Rinne goes to collect it, but the fortune teller won't give up her crystal ball without a fight.

5.t: Kuroboshi Sansei / The Lucky Pot / Bamboo Shoot in Rainbow Color
5.o: Tamako asks Rinne to train a young black cat to support a Shinigami, but this cat's particular phobia gets in the way. Later, Rinne hopes to intercept a "lucky" pot of money!

6.t: Special Protected Sacred Bird / June Bride / The Safe from Hell
6.o: Shoma offers to pay Rinne handsomely to take care of a sacred bird, forgetting to mention the bird's frightening appetite. Later, Sakura meets the ghost of an angry bride.

7.t: Wandering Power Stone / Poltergeist / The Taboo in the Shinigami World
7.o: Jumonji finally gets a chance to impress Sakura when he tries to quell a mischievous spirit. Later, Sakura and Rinne help a "creepy" spirit give the performance of his life.

8.t: Open After Seven Days / Silver Scythe / Prince of the Shinigami
8.o: A cursed doll from Ageha's past comes to haunt Renge. Later, Rinne helps a spirit by setting her up on a date with Matsugo, despite Matsugo's lingering affections for Rinne!

9.t: Apologize in the Altar Room / Goddess of Wisdom / River of Treasure
9.o: Sabato falls victim to the mackerel curse! Later, Jumonji invites Sakura to study for a test at his place, only to have his alone time with her horribly interrupted.

10.t: The First Union Meeting / An Ominous Prophecy
10.o: Someone is trying to take over the Damashigami Company! Later, when Renge tries to steal Annette's Peep Ball, she sees a vision of Kain... putting handcuffs on her?

11.t: Mystery of the Flower Field / I Will Lend You My Right Arm / Black Report Card
11.o: A search for Kain goes awry as Ageha and Matsugo continue to fight for Rinne's affection. Later, Sakura notices that Rinne, who never studies, is passing every test. How?

12.t: Evil Spirit in the Summer House / Eggplant Romance / One Coin Investigation
12.o: Rinne tries to purify a poltergeist, and Sakura helps a spirit who's scared of eggplants. Later, the group takes a trip to a festival to bust a Damashigami scheme.

13.o: While visiting a pawn shop Rinne discovers something related to his mother, and learns more about her. Later, Sakura and Rinne check on a little girl who can see spirits.

14.o: Sabato reveals an interesting detail concerning the disappearance of Rinne's mother, leading the others to a startling revelation about little Ichigo's true identity.

15.t: Kokkuri-san / Cursed Piggy Bank / The Hated Sansei
15.o: Ichigo asks Rinne to banish "Kokkuri-san". Sabato tries to offload a cursed piggy bank. Later, Sansei makes another attempt to fight his fear of spirits.

16.t: Curse of Splurge / The Cursed Peep Ball
16.o: Stingy Annette finds herself suddenly unable to save money. Is it truly a snake spirit's curse? Later, Masato attempts to sabotage Rinne's happiness... again.

17.t: Head Man / When You Wish Upon the Moon / The First Saury Festival
17.o: Refuto hires Rinne to protect an offering of delicious dumplings. Later, Rinne looks forward to a Saury Festival... with one hidden condition.

18.t: The Practical Training for Capturing a Dream Demon
18.o: Rinne's dreams are being invaded by a Dream Demon. To stop the madness, Rinne and Matsugo have to capture a it in a world where one person's dream is another's nightmare!

19.t: Nothing Inside / Mystery of Koshikudake Hill / Effect of the Matsutake Mushroom
19.o: Incidents around steamed buns make life difficult for Rinne and Rokumon. Later, Rinne experiences a problem originating from a mysterious package of mushrooms.

20.t: Wings of Celebration / Kabakichi-kun / Scream of a Cassette Tape
20.o: Something terrible has happened to Matsugo: he's turned into an angel! Worse, he's HELPING people! Later, Sakura and Ichigo bump into Shoma as he tries to help a hippo spirit.

21.t: Black Square Thing / Shortcut Through the Alley
21.o: Rinne is suspected of stealing money at his own school! On the hunt to find the actual perpetrator, he discovers how little faith his friends have in him and his poverty.

22.t: A Ring and Stamp / Food at the Porch / Black Cat Children’s Association
22.o: Ageha has one last chance to stop her sister from making the biggest mistake of her life: marrying Sabato! Later, Rinne discovers that Rokumon may have a secret food supply.

23.t: Good Luck Wax / Maneko and Kotomi / Where’s My Money?!
23.o: The new wax finish on Rinne's scythe is attracting coins! Later, Sakura helps her friends Miho and Rika when a walking mannequin attacks them.

24.t: Supplemental Class for Fierce Dog Catching / Money Spirit / Evil Spirit’s Legacy
24.o: Sakura finds herself dealing with a fierce dog spirit... but is he really a dog? Later, Rinne wonders if his never ending money problems can be solved by a money spirit.

25.o: Matsugo invites Rinne to his school festival, so (of course) Sakura, Jumonji, and Renge come along. The festival's ghost-house proves more dangerous than they thought.

1.o: During a mission to eradicate a vampire priest and his minions, Alucard is forced into a difficult decision upon encountering an injured police woman. Later Alucard encounters a mysterious warrior from the Vatican.

2.o: Two daring vampire brothers lead a violent raid on the Hellsing compound. The carnage is great, but Alucard and company manage to gain a key piece of information while turning the battle’s tide.

3.o: The Hellsing organization resorts to the recruitment of mercenaries in the wake of a devastating attack on headquarters, and Integra’s suspicions concerning the origins of their enemy are confirmed.

4.o: An important meeting between Hellsing and the Queen is interrupted by tidings of impending war. Meanwhile, Alucard is sent to deal with the deviants responsible for the hijacking of an aircraft carrier.

5.o: While Alucard is trapped aboard an aircraft carrier, London is plagued by a gruesome vampire onslaught. Elsewhere, Integra narrowly escapes a horde of Nazi vampires.

6.o: The Vatican’s formidable combat unit is mobilized in preparation for battle. Back in the heart of London, the Hellsing Mansion is attacked, and the Wild Geese represent the last line of defense against the undead.

7.o: When her memories are violated, Seras becomes trapped in an illusion which forces her to relive the most horrifying moments of her life. Upon waking from the nightmare, the real pain begins as the battle nears its end.

8.o: The harrowing conclusion to Hellsing Ultimate features the epic return of Alucard and Integra’s willingness to unleash his true power on their enemies!

9.o: Alucard faces off with father Anderson. Meanwhile, the Major starts to put his last parts of his plan into motion.

10.o: And now an ending. London is in ruins, Enrico's crusade has failed, captain Bernadotte and Alexander Anderson has fallen and Walter has defected to Millenium. As Alucard duels Walter, Seras and Integra fights through the zeppelin Deus Ec Machina and faces the last remaining soldiers of Millenium. But there also waits the leaders of Millenium: the Major and the mysterious Captain, the man Walter feared to face and who is about to reveal his true nature...

1.o: Between bemoaning his ex, performing an exorcism and playing field hockey, Kaz Kaan has little time to worry about his place among Neo Yokio society.

2.t: A Pop Star of Infinite Elegance
2.o: The Black and White Ball is approaching and Kaz has problems galore, including a disinterested date, a scheming rival and (gasp!) the wrong color tux.

3.o: Kaz visits his old school to teach a trio of insolent students about elegance. Meanwhile, Gottlieb and Lexy ask Kaz to endorse their new cocktail.

4.o: Distressing news sends Kaz to the Hamptons to settle some family affairs. While there, he learns there's more to Charles than he thought.

5.o: Kaz finds that keeping the Soviet Union's Grand Prix driver out of trouble is surprisingly difficult. Meanwhile, Arcangelo makes a peace offering.

6.t: I'm Starting to Think Neo Yokio's Not the Greatest City in the World
6.o: Kaz and his friends vow to help Helena escape the Remembrancer's clutches, but the Grand Prix complicates their escape.

1.o: Gary carries out the final days of his prison sentence aboard the Galaxy One, when he meets Mooncake, an alien who is being chased by bounty hunters; Gary swears to keep Mooncake safe, not knowing the alien is a planet-destroying super weapon.

2.o: Gary and Avocato must chase down the ruthless bounty hunter, Terk, before he can tell the Lord Commander that Mooncake is aboard the Galaxy One.

3.o: Gary tries to hide Mooncake safely away on the planet Yarno; Gary and Avocato are trapped in a terrifying mind-puzzle; Mooncake is forced to fight in a combat arena called the Deathcropolis; Quinn investigates the gravitational disturbance.

4.o: After the Galaxy One is hacked by the Infinity Guard, Gary has to harvest energy from a nearby star to reignite the engines; the radiation poisoning from the star sends Gary into a trance of painful memories; Gary and Quinn are finally reunited.

5.o: Quinn realizes the only people she can trust are Gary and the crew of the Galaxy One.

6.o: Gary goes on a mission to save Avocato's son, Little Cato, from Lord Commander's Prison Planet, but it turns out to be a trap; Quinn sees Gary's vlogs and understands that he is someone who would risk his life for any of his friends.

7.o: Gary grapples with his future when he learns that his prison sentence is over.

8.o: Gary and the crew encounter a Titan, who tells them how to close the breach in the fabric of space.

9.o: Gary and Quinn go back to Earth to find an anti-gravitational bomb that can close the breach in space. Gary and Quinn decide to turn this life-threatening adventure into their first date.

10.o: The finale to our epic adventure. An all out battle ensues as The Lord Commander does everything in his power to capture Mooncake, and stop Gary and Quinn from closing the entrance to Final Space.

1.o: Gary is rescued from the wreckage of space then must earn his freedom by winning the deadliest race in the galaxy.

2.o: The crew gets trapped in a happy ship where things aren't what they seem; Gary must confront the human cost of having lost Earth.

3.o: The search for a dimensional key leads the Crimson Light to Ash's home planet. HUE hosts a bachelor party for an unexpected visitor.

4.o: A collision with space time traps half of the Crimson Light in a perilous other dimension.

5.o: Gary reconnects with the mother who abandoned him; Mooncake misses Gary's attention.

6.o: When Mooncake is mysteriously taken from the Crimson Light, the crew must find him in the nether reaches of space; Tribore rebuilds the resistance.

7.o: Nightfall attempts to bring the past back to life, leaving the crew powerless against a pack of evil KVNs.

8.o: An unexpected trip through time provides a unique opportunity for the crew.

9.o: Gary discovers a way he may be able to communicate with Quinn; Tribore reconnects with a resistance fighter who has an ulterior motive.

10.o: Gary and crew search Galang 22 for Little Cato; Clarence, Fox and Ash pull off their greatest con; Sheryl's secrets come out.

11.o: An act of betrayal shakes the crew; Hue and Mooncake have a day out for themselves.

12.o: The search for the stolen dimensional keys leads the crew to a planet being sucked into the Dark Zone; Hue and Ava get closer.

13.o: With the dimensional keys recovered, the crew travel to Inner Space where they finally try to free Bolo.

1.o: After a escaping a near death encounter with Invictus, The Team Squad begins their quest home inside the core of an unknown planet.

2.o: Gary and Quinn encounter Earth's last survivor and search for a ship so that they can save the others lost in Final Space.

3.o: The Lord Commander tries to pry information about Mooncake's whereabouts out of Avocato. Quinn keeps her sickness a secret from Gary.

4.o: Gary hatches another hair-brained plan to rescue his crew.

5.o: Final Space is such a hole.  I mean like its the biggest hole in the universe.  Like weight of a thousand suns kind of hole.  What I'm getting at is we are being sucked into a black hole and we're all definitely about to die.

6.o: Gary and the crew race to find a cure for Quinn's Final Space poisoning, while Ash confronts Invictus. Meanwhile, Tribore and Quatronostro find out about a prophecy and journey to the great oracle Tim Belts.

7.o: As an infection grows within Bolo, the crew races to help before he's lost to them forever.

8.o: The aftermath of losing one of the crew ripples through the team squad.

9.o: The crew heads to Earth in an attempt to activate the Hyper-Trans Dimensional Bridge, but in order to do so they must make contact with someone on the other side of Final Space.

10.o: Gary and Quinn go on a perilous mission to activate the Titan killing apparatus, while Avocato races to stop the Lord Commander's ultimate transformation.

11.o: The crew fight to survive a ship-wide invasion of possessed Garys.

12.o: Long held secrets are revealed that will change the Team Squad forever.

13.o: A shattered Team Squad is left reeling as Gary and Avocato travel into Invictus' inner sanctum for the final showdown.

1.o: Policeman Omer and team have made a big bust. He and girlfriend Sibil are about to be formally engaged. Jewelry designer Elif comes home from her job in Rome for her birthday celebration. Then tragedy brings these two families together.

2.o: Elif and Omer are having a hard time dealing with the manner of their loved ones' deaths. Elif is shocked by the massive business problems left behind by her father, as well as the men wanting her to settle her father's debts.

3.o: Omer is doing his own investigation, to the anger of his superiors. Nilufer heads to the airport with Elif to return to school in the US with promised help from Tayyar, but others have different plans. Friends are not who they really seem.

4.o: Elif keeps lying to Omer trying not to tell him about Nilufer. She goes to Sibil's home where the women are paying their respects. Elif searches Sibil's room and finds a surprising link to her own father. Omer confronts her as she leaves.

11.o: Elif and Ömer plot a detailed scheme, but her lies get in the way. Metin raises the stakes in his blackmail campaign.

12.o: Bahar and Levent set their plan in motion. When Metin learns the truth, he seizes a rare chance for revenge.

1.t: The High School Girl and Thighs
1.o: High school girl Futo Momoko is napping in the classroom when her best friends Furui Mayumi and Shibusawa Shibumi drop in. Later, when Momoko is relaxing alone, a mosquito flies into the room.

2.t: The High School Girl and the Unlucky Day
2.o: Momoko is watching TV before school, and the morning horoscope says that her sign will have the worst luck today. Despite her dread, Momoko leaves for school, and one bad thing after another threatens to ruin her day.

3.t: The High School Girl and Drowsiness
3.o: Fukuouda Tadashi boards his train very sleepy, but seated in front of where he's standing is Momoko. He tries to make himself look cool, but epically fails. To add insult to injury, he unwraps a stick of gum, but then drops it right between Momoko's thighs...

4.t: The High School Girl and the Family Restaurant
4.o: Momoko, Shibumi, and Mayumi are at a family restaurant. Momoko is out of money, so she can only watch while the other two eat. She ends up occupying herself by making animals out of the restaurant napkins.

5.t: The High School Girl and the Skateboard
5.o: Momoko, Shibumi, and Mayumi visit a family restaurant. Momoko can only watch the other two eat since she doesn't have the money to order anything, so instead she starts to make animals out of the napkins.

6.t: The High School Girl and Working Out
6.o: Momoko's sister, Kizuku, sees a special on TV about a weight loss routine and suddenly feels that there's too much fat around her belly. So she tries to do the exercises they did on TV...

7.t: The High School Girl and the Foggy Window
7.o: On a snowy day, Momoku, Shibumi, and Mayumi start to breathe on the classroom window glass and draw in the fog with their fingers. Their drawings quickly disappear, but later, when steam from a teapot fills the room...

8.t: The High School Girl and Hiding from the Rain
8.o: Fukoda is taking shelter from the rain in a bus stop, when Momoko comes along and takes cover under the same shelter. As he sees Momoko's wet shirt and the way she ties up her hair, Fukoda starts to feel rather tense...

9.t: The High School Girl and Shadow Puppets
9.o: At lunch time on the day Furui Mayumi transfers to Futaba Girls' High School, she finds herself seated next to Momoko, who suddenly strikes an intimidating pose with her hands. This scares Mayumi at first, but then...

10.t: The High School Girl and the Hair Barrette
10.o: As an elementary school student, Shibumi proposed a rule prohibiting the use of keyholder accessories, which was met with strong opposition from her classmates. The next day, Shibumi wore a hair barrette that her grandma had given her to school...

11.t: The High School Girl and the Kotatsu
11.o: Momoko, Shibumi, and Mayumi are sitting under the kotatsu at Momoko's house, playing around as they peel tangerines. And when they're finished with that, they continue to have fun playing with the kotatsu.

12.t: The High School Girl and the Road Home
12.o: Momoko, Shibumi, and Mayumi are walking home from school together, laughing and having fun as always. The everyday life of these high school girls continues today as it always has.

1.o: The Allies must capture the Abbaye d'Ardenne, which guards the city of Caen but is held by a notorious Panzer unit accused of horrific war crimes.

2.o: Desperate to feed the Allied advance after D-Day, US forces target a deep water port in France during a month long siege against Nazi paratroopers.

3.o: As winter sets in, US Rangers must capture Hill 400, a strategic peak on the German border.

4.o: German and American soldiers fight together to save French VIP prisoners from Nazi troops.

1.o: Hoping to develop a drug to awaken his long-comatose sister, genetics engineer Murat attends a shamanic ritual to research the effects of ayahuasca.

2.o: The events that happened during Murat's lost hours are revealed. The police question those who were the last to see Ayhan before his body was found.

3.o: Selin receives a message alluding to a secret she's keeping. Murat tracks down the doctor who was supposed to perform Ayhan's heart transplant.

4.o: During a forced hospital stay, Murat tells his uncle about being taken to the secret operating room, where he learned why his father was murdered.

5.o: After Ceyla decides to try Murat's experimental drug on herself, her personality changes dramatically and she visits Murat at his home.

6.o: Selin obtains security camera footage that shows who's been leaving the messages for her. Murat gets a call inviting him to meet his father's killer.

7.o: At a nightclub, Murat's alter ego witnesses an altercation between one of his students and her boyfriend, and takes matters into his own hands.

8.o: Salim and Ferit help Murat cover all tracks linking him to the body in his car. Doğan confesses to Utku's mother the part he played in Utku's death.

9.o: Murat awakens to find a body and cleaning crew in his home, but the cleanup goes awry. Ezo begins repeating a foreign-language phrase in her sleep.

10.o: Yıldız orders Vecdi and Süha to kill Doğan, who now knows too much. Suspicious of Murat's recent odd behavior, Selin tracks down fired doctor Ömer.

11.o: Ceyla hypnotizes Murat so he can retain memories while taking his drug. Murat finds a way to contact the man who ordered his father's murder.

12.o: In her sleep, Ezo asks to speak to Ceyla, to whom she makes a desperate plea. Murat learns how Yıldız is connected to his father's death.

13.o: Ezo gets revenge. Ceyla makes alarming allegations against Murat that lead Selin to accept a dinner date with him in hopes of getting a confession.

1.t: This Is An MTB Battle! Kore ga MTB BATTLE da!
1.o: Chaos at home, Sho Yamato races to the X-Zone. Black smoke transports him and rival Gabu to a strange new world. They're arrested for illegal biking.

2.t: Big Escape! Sand Dune Battle Daidassou! Sakyuu no tatakai
2.o: Sho and his friends are lost in a treacherous world. Facing danger and competition, they must use their mountain biking skills to escape. Will they find their way home?

3.t: Crash! The First Defeat? Shougeki! Hajimete no haiboku?
3.o: Sho and his friends battle Gabu's team in the treacherous X-Zone. Can they overcome this setback and emerge stronger?

4.t: Take Back! My MTB! Torimodose! Ore no MTB!
4.o: Sho's prized MTB, Flame Kaiser, is stolen. He must race against skilled rivals, using his bike skills and strategy, to reclaim it and win.

5.t: Fiery Volcano Battle!! Honoo no kazan no BATTLE!!
5.o: Sho and his friends face a volcanic race, battling tough terrain and rivals. Can their MTB skills and teamwork conquer the dangerous obstacles and win?

6.t: A High-Tech Group's Challenge HIGH-TECH shuudan no chousen
6.o: Sho and his friends face the Hyper Brain team in a thrilling MTB race. Can Sho use his skills and tactics to outpace their rivals and claim victory?

7.t: Ouch! MTB's Graveyard Auu! MTB no hakaba
7.o: Sho and his friends battle rivals in the MTB Cemetery, a graveyard of abandoned bikes with treacherous terrain. Can they overcome the obstacles and conquer the challenge?

8.o: The legendary Neptune bike holds secrets. A team faces rivals for its power. Can Sho master it and win?

9.t: The Identity Of The Masked Boy Kamen shounen no shoutai
9.o: Sho Yamato and his team unveil the Mask Rider's secret identity, uncovering the motive behind their actions. Can they adapt their strategy to defeat this growing threat?

10.o: Sho's toughest MTB race yet pits them against a rival with unmatched skill and a powerful bike. Can Sho and their team rise to the challenge?

11.o: Sho races aboard a massive ship, navigating narrow paths, and shifting terrain. Can Sho outmanoeuvre his opponents and claim victory in this challenging race?

12.o: Sho Yamato's dream of becoming the best rider is on the line. Facing tough rivals, his fierce determination will be tested. Can he win the thrilling race?

13.o: Sho Yamato and his friends navigate a treacherous school, dodging obstacles and battling skilled riders. Can Sho adapt to this unique race and claim victory?

14.t: The Man Who Beat Flame Kaiser?
14.o: In a mining town, children meet siblings Saya and her brother. Saya claims her brother can defeat Flame Kaizer, but his strange behavior hints at a hidden secret.

15.o: Makoto arrives at the Aqua Palace, destined to be the prince's bride. But he holds a secret - he's Team ST. Her mission: uncover his truth. Will she succeed?

16.t: Struggle In The Rain, Awakened Neptune
16.o: A month-long journey to X City leaves the kids disheartened. A broken trailer and Makoto's quitting spark a heated battle. Who will prevail?

17.o: Yuki's shortcut to X-City plunges them into a demon-haunted cavern. As fear grips Sho and his friends, a mysterious figure emerges. Can they survive the darkness?

18.t: A New Assassin! The Test's Battle Between Siblings
18.o: Shido doubts Makoto's Neptune awakening. To travel to X City, Sho and Makoto must pass a tough test. Will they succeed?

19.t: Showdown! Flame Kaiser VS. Thunder Emperor
19.o: Despite passing the test, Shido still calls Sho immature, fuelling Sho's frustration. They agree to settle the score with an Idaten Battle. Who will win the battle?

20.o: Sho's battle with Shido is interrupted by Koei's ninja skills, sending Shido falling. Sho trains fiercely, blindfolded, to prepare for the final showdown against Koei. Can he win?

21.o: Reaching X-City's gate, the kids are denied entry. Facing the Guardian Brothers, they must navigate a treacherous battle course. Can they overcome the obstacles and gain access?

22.o: X City falls under the tyrannical grip of Team Shark Tooth. Sho, fueled by righteous anger, challenges their leader, Tiger Jiro, to an Idaten Battle. Will justice prevail?

23.o: Sho arrives in X-City just as the I Daten tournament kicks off. The prize: 7 Gold Emblems. Can she win and return home a champion?

24.o: Sho is ready for the tournament, but his first opponent is Makoto. Will he face his friend in a duel? Who will take the title?

25.o: The B Block heats up with Samejima Taiga, Gen, Arthur, and more battling for supremacy. Who will emerge victorious in this fierce clash?

26.o: Sho and his friends fight for his return home in an epic tournament. But what is Keoichi's secret weapon?

27.o: Sho gets a dream about his father who encourages him to focus on the finals. Furthermore, Gabu fires Taiga after his defeat. Will this bring repurcussions to the tournament?

28.o: Gabu manipulates the competition to ensure Koei's victory, but Koei, disillusioned by the deceit, confronts him. Will Koei betray his principles for success?

29.t: Final Battle! Who Will Be The Victor?
29.o: Gabu executes his devious plan and gets Kiku kidnapped. He tries to use her to gain advantage over Koei. Will Sho and his friends be able to rescue Kiku and protect her?

30.o: Sho and friends bask in victory, but Gabu has a trick up his sleeve. What mischievous scheme is he plotting?

31.t: Decisive Battle! Flame Kaiser VS. Bloody Fang
31.o: Sho wins the Idaten Battle, but Gabu steals the emblems. As Sho battles Gabu, the Four Kings take away the emblems. Will show be able to retrieve back what is rightfully his?

32.o: While wandering around in the tower, Sho catches a glimpse of Imperial X. Meanwhile Gabu is furious at his defeat. Will he take another hasty step out of anger?

33.o: Sho's dream of Miss Yuki and his father's secret is shattered by a tide. He desperately tries to convince Ayumu and his mom about the X-Zone's existence.

34.o: Sho and his friends crave a return to X Zone, but their path remains unclear. A bike repair sparks conflict, putting their mission in jeopardy.

35.o: After a tremendous battle with some mysterious people, Sho and his friends find clues about his dad's disappearance. Will they find out the truth?

36.o: Sho and his friends chase Team X to Imperial Island to retrieve the stolen Imperial X. Ayumu's kidnapping complicates their mission. Can Sho rescue his friend and reclaim the X?

37.o: Sho, victorious in Massaji, continues his quest. But a new challenge awaits: Kyoichi's Team X. Count Freddy, under orders, must test Sho's strength - but can he win?

38.t: Gabu's Allure, Flame Kaiser's In A Pinch!
38.o: On their journey to Imperial Island, Sho and Hosuke encounter Sayji and Mantaro. A cryptic letter from Gabu throws their plans into question.

39.t: Climax! Imperial Dragon VS. Aero Scissors Hakunetsu!
39.o: Sho and friends blindly search Imperial Island for Team X's hidden HQ. Elsewhere, Koei secretly visits his ill sister, warning her to conceal their sibling bond from Team X.

40.o: Sho and his friends face perils in X-Zone's Nameless Forest, determined to reach Imperial Island. But danger lurks, testing their resolve. Will they make it?

41.o: Makoto and Sho unite their Idaten Bikes for an epic "Idaten Cross," powering through a waterfall to advance in their race. Can their combined strength propel them to victory?

42.o: Sho, Makoto, and Arthur jump across sea pillars to reach Imperial Island, overcoming the final challenge in their journey. Will they successfully complete their adventure?

43.t: Sho VS. Shido! Battle Of Life Or Death!
43.o: Shaw and Keoichi face off in a high-stakes duel that tests their deepest convictions. As their souls clash, who will emerge victorious in this ultimate battle for supremacy?

44.o: Imperial X reveals its terrifying true form, plunging the world into chaos and fear. What dark secrets lie behind this revelation?

45.t: The Second Island Appears! The Beginning Of The World's Collapse
45.o: A new island rises from the depths, shaking the world's foundations and spreading panic. As the landscape shifts, can the heroes prevent the impending disaster?

46.t: Charge! Team X VS. Imperial Dragon Daishuugeki!
46.o: Takeshi's dark power threatens to engulf X-Zone. Can anyone stop the escalating chaos before it consumes everything?

47.t: The Legendary Training Grounds, Sho's Special Training!
47.o: Sho faces ultimate tests in legendary training grounds, pushing him to his limits. Will he emerge stronger or fall?

48.o: Sho discovers a miracle power, unleashing a new secret move with explosive force. As his opponents are caught off guard, can Sho master this power in time to secure victory?

49.o: Gabu watches Kyoichi, Sho, and Makoto perform, a knowing smile on his face. He wonders if Sho can overcome the challenge of facing Neptune.

50.o: Sho and his friends face unexpected obstacles as they journey to mysterious Imperial Island. Will they overcome the challenges and reach their destination?

51.t: The Battle of Destiny,The Final Battle!
51.o: Imperial Island hangs in the balance as Sho and his friends face their ultimate test. Destiny awaits, but will they rise to the challenge?

52.o: The fate of X-Zone rests on Sho and his friends' shoulders as they unlock a new power to restore balance. Time is running out.

1.o: The Subway Police of Wangsoori Station is led by Chief Inspector Ko Ji Seok. He is the best of the best, although his only goal in life is to have a stable, uneventful career. However, a serial killer, nicknamed “the Subway Ghost”, strikes the Subway Police 30 Year Anniversary event. An applicant shows up for a job interview to join the team.

2.o: Ryung officially becomes a member of the Wangsoori Subway Police and Ji Seok’s partner. Ryung gets into trouble from the start, because she sneaks into the tunnels. Meanwhile, an elderly man who delivers packages via subway becomes the victim of an assault. Ji Seok realizes that the package is related to criminal activities. While Ji Seok wants to hand the case over, Ryung acts before she thinks, as always.

3.o: Ryung and Ji Seok attend the disciplinary committee hearing and return to the station for night duty. Thanks to Ji Seok’s martial arts demonstration and a pot of noodles, Ryung gets her hands on the screen door keys once more. Meanwhile, an ordinary father, whose livelihood takes place on the subway, goes missing.

4.o: Ryung and Ji Seok save Choi Do Chul just in time. Throughout their investigation, Ji Seok miraculously learns to appreciate Ryung’s over-the-top nature. Meanwhile, a star professional fighter becomes the PR Ambassador for the Subway Police. By chance, Ryung comes across his dirty secret and the Wangsoori Subway Police finally get a lead on the Grasshoppers.

5.o: Ji Seok makes up his mind to kick Ryung out of the Subway Police for taking investigations into her own hands all the time. However, Ryung is attacked while out on an investigation by herself and there is something weird about the man who seems to be following her. Meanwhile, the Wangsoori Subway Police get dressed up to go out on Club Day, the best day to boost their arrest records.

6.o: A rumor circulates about people disappearing after they party all night on Club Day, then taking the first train home. Ryung and Ji Seok get on the first train to find out whether the rumor is true. During their train ride, they run into a suspicious petty thief and the truth about the first train rumor comes to light. Meanwhile, Ryung finally meets the Subway Ghost a month after joining the Subway Police.

7.o: Subway Police and the Metropolitan Detective Division come together for a joint investigation. Despite Ji Seok’s jealousy, the joint investigation team switch partners. Ji Seok and Ma Ri become one team, while Ryung and Woo Hyuk become another. Meanwhile, Ji Seok decides to let Ryung transfer to a different team. As Ma Ri approaches him again, Ji Seok feels confused.

8.o: Ma Ri leaves Ryung after saying harsh words that keep replaying in Ryung’s mind. Still, Ryung continues her search for the Subway Ghost. But this time, she comes across someone willing to help. Meanwhile, an autistic boy goes missing from the bakery in Wangsoori Station and the Grasshoppers are on a pickpocketing spree once again. Ji Seok and Ryung have different priorities in which case to pursue.

9.t: Getting Closer to the Subway Ghost
9.o: Ryung and Ji Seok work together to save Jung Hoon and catch the kidnapper. With their great partnership, they discover the identity of the person who helps the kidnapper hide from the police. Meanwhile, the Subway Ghost marks his next target and Ryung activates her subway search skills to track him down.

10.o: The Subway Ghost’s hideout is finally uncovered. Through the evidence found in the hideout, the police slowly start to piece together the Subway Ghost’s identity. Meanwhile, Ryung’s illegal investigations in the tunnels come to the attention of the commissioner and Ji Seok faces the biggest crisis in his career.

11.o: The police make headway on the Subway Serial Murders and narrow down the suspect list. After getting a tip about the identity of one of the Grasshoppers, Ryung and the Metropolitan Detective Division chase him down as he might be the Subway Ghost. Meanwhile, Ji Seok’s investigative instincts start acting up again, despite his suspension.

12.o: One of the Grasshoppers gets away from the police. The other two Grasshoppers confess that they only know him as Han Tae Woong, although that name turns out to be a fake identity. The investigation reaches a dead end and Ji Seok is about to be reassigned to a remote island. Ryung comes up with a plan to save Ji Seok and to catch the Subway Ghost.

13.o: Ji Seok and Ryung catch the remaining Grasshopper who everyone believes is the Subway Ghost. However, while being interrogated, the Captain of the Grasshoppers makes a shocking statement. The truth about the Subway Serial Murder Case finally begins to reveal itself and Ryung is hopeful that she may find out what happened to her sister.

14.o: The police believe the Subway Ghost is in a mental hospital and that he plans to commit another murder. They chase him down and search the entire hospital building. Amid the chaos, Ji Seok’s mom and her caretaker are nowhere to be found. The Subway Ghost leaves behind a video clip, revealing himself and the shocking truth.

15.o: Ryung and Ji Seok make their way into Kyung Hee’s house and find a room that looks like a young girl’s. After sharing the new evidence with Ma Ri and her team, they split up into two groups to chase both Kyung Hee and Yi Joon. Meanwhile, Ryung’s hopes of finding Jin alive begin to grow and Ji Seok gets a call from the hospital about his mom.

16.o: Finally, Ryung and the Subway Ghost come face to face. As his rage explodes, the Subway Ghost attacks Ryung, but another tragedy puts a stop to his actions in the end. Meanwhile, Jin appears at the scene, only to run away amidst the chaos. Ryung, the Subway Police, and Ma Ri’s team put in all their efforts into reuniting the twin sisters.

1.o: The story begins with the world of Lotfi Damanhouri, a great and ruthless businessman who exploits everyone around him for his benefit, and does not care about his family as a father. Sunbul arrives at Lotfi's palace to work, but causes disaster and chaos. Naama Sunbul is fired, but he is begging her to work in her home. Sonbol seeks to obtain his rights from the land that his uncle sold to Lotfi. Sonbol quarrels with a stranger in the house, only to discover that he is Lutfi.

3.o: A couple and a mother-in-law are presented with everything from their wish list including a ranch-dressing fountain and a hope-filled nursery.

4.o: Did someone say, "Big, fat gay wedding"? Two lesbian lovebirds look for space to hold a community celebration and a property complete with a sunporch.

5.o: A self-proclaimed princess and her army prince aim to find a forever home or tie the knot with a horse-drawn carriage, all before his deployment.

6.o: Proud wives-to-be are split on investing in a space for their growing family versus taking the opportunity to showcase their love to the world.

7.o: Partners in faith and in love compare the price tags of a welcoming haven for their community and holy matrimony with Nashville hot wedding favors.

8.o: After eight years together, Raven and Antonio envision exchanging vows at a picture-perfect wedding — and raising their sons in a spacious home.

9.o: Picturing a life together out of their parents' homes, a young couple must choose between an Instaworthy doughnut wall and a perfect bathroom.

10.t: A Little Bit Classy and Trashy
10.o: In love with an accessible home sporting a big garage but also hoping for a moonshine-toast reception, a war veteran and a singer weigh their options.

1.o: On a remote island in the Pacific, Will Smith descends into the heart of an active volcano to investigate sounds beyond human hearing. Will discovers that everything on our planet creates its own unique sound—even if we can’t always hear it.

2.o: In a deep-water submersible, Will Smith descends 3,300 feet to the bottom of the ocean, where even fewer people have gone than outer space. Along the way down, Will and explorer Diva Amon investigate how color is used in the natural world.

3.o: Thirty years ago, Will Smith was mesmerized by a photo of the incredible wildebeest migration across the Serengeti in a National Geographic magazine. Now he visits those same wildebeests and discovers an amazing survival strategy.

4.o: On the trail of tiger sharks in the Pacific, Will explores the power of smell. For humans, the sense of smell triggers deep memories and emotions, but it has an even more vital function in the animal world.

5.o: Will explores the Namibia Desert, where both the landscape and time seem to have stood still for over 50 million years. Will discovers that humans can only see a small sliver of what’s moving around us because everything on the planet is happening either too fast or too slow for us to perceive.

6.o: For Will’s final journey, an ultimate challenge. He and polar explorer Dwayne Fields are dropped by helicopter in the middle of an Icelandic glacier.

2.o: Tom joins the fire brigade, immediately drawing suspicion from Nina. Despite their differences, Orlando and Dominique must learn to work together.

3.o: After the explosion, Gio blames himself for the incident with the fire hydrant. Dominique encourages Orlando to take the adjunct exam.

4.o: Patrick investigates the faulty fire hydrants and enlists help from his old team. Tom and Nina try to reconcile their differences.

7.o: The firefighters lead the search for a missing woman. A momentary lapse of judgment hurts Orlando's chances of getting a promotion.
